decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (15/2611, 23 - 02- 100 - HVAC Rev. F, 123 - 02- 101 - HVAC Rev. H, 123 - 02- 200 - HVAC Rev. G, 123 - 02- 110 - HVAC Rev. H, 123 - 02- 111 - HVAC Rev. A, 123 - 00- 100 Rev. E, 123 - 00- 101 Rev. E, 123 - 00- 200 Rev. E, 123 - 00- 110 Rev. E, 123 - 00- 111 Rev. E, Plant Noise Assessment prepared by RBA Acoustics (Rev. 3, dated 10 February 2016), Planning, Heritage, Design and Access Statement -Installation of External Plant prepared by Planning Potential Ltd. (dated 18 January 2015), Purified Electrostatic Precipitator brochure prepared by Purified Air Limited (dated 20/09/2011), UV-C and UV-O Odour Control
Technology brochure prepared by Purified Air Limited (no date). Received 26 January 2016) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The cumulative noise level from all plant and equipment shall not exceed 33dBLAeq at the nearest residential window at 3a Prince of Wales Terrace.
